name: pumpToContinuous
signature: export function pumpToContinuous(effect: Extract<Effect, { do: 'pump' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
contract: Produces one ContinuousEffect naming exactly the permanents the selector resolves to at resolution time (CR 613.6 locks the set).
Power and toughness are evaluated once, here, to plain numbers; a ValueExpr must never reach the layer engine unevaluated.
A `grant` list adds a second EffectPart at sublayer 6a in the same effect, so one timestamp covers both.
Resolving against an empty selector produces no continuous effect and one deferred line, never a silent nothing.
The effect id is derived from env, never minted from a uuid or a clock.
Emits zero GameActions: a pump changes no state the reducer owns.

evidence.claim: the default duration is end of turn
it adds to power and toughness rather than setting them

assertions.expect: one continuous effect, sublayer 7c, modify-pt +3/+3, affecting only the bear

assertions.given: the same effect fed to computeLayers

assertions.expect: two parts, 7c and 6a, in one effect with one id and one timestamp
no continuous effect and exactly one deferred line

assertions.given: the same call run twice with the same env
assertions.expect: byte-identical results including the effect id

assertions.given: power expressed as {v:'count'} over two creatures
assertions.expect: the part carries the number 2, not the expression
